description: Saves the user's own text of one message step (free). result_id and expected_revision from get_outreach_lead protect against an edit made meanwhile. [REST: PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/outreach/leads/{cid}/steps/{step_id}]

step_id.description: The step id of the message (get_outreach_lead steps[].step_id).

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: edit_outreach_message
title: Edit a message by hand
